rationale: Roberts is likely to assign to Kagan (or keep it) to capture the conference “middle ground”: courts may consider intervening developments but cannot grant compassionate release on a theory that requires deeming the original judgment unlawful in the § 2255 sense. Separate writings are most likely from Alito/Thomas (to harden the anti-end-run principle) and from Sotomayor/Jackson (to reject an atextual exclusion and emphasize a remedial—not evidentiary—limit).
